description: Returns url, a one-time Telegram link valid 15 minutes (expiresInSec): the wallet owner opens it in Telegram and presses Start; the bot then sends the alerts and offers its controls, like linking Telegram on waketrades.com. Linking activates copying as on the website (one free trial per Telegram account). Needs leaders (set_copy_settings, else leader_required) and the confirmed trading key (confirm_trading_key, else key_required). name (optional): the wallet's name in the bot, for example Main. Signed-in wallet only: with a code from the person's Profile it answers wallet_required, and the person links Telegram on waketrades.com. A new call replaces the previous link.

name.description: Wallet name shown in the bot (optional): 1 to 20 letters, digits, spaces, - or _

name: link_telegram
title: Link Telegram (link for the person to open)
